summary: Débora.ai MVP frontend smoke tested. All critical flows working: login (mock auth), dashboard KPIs, theme toggle (dark/light), sidebar collapse, tenant selector, notifications+mark-all-read, Leads CRUD + rotation, CRM Kanban (6 cols/18 cards) + tab switch + funnels, Inventory (18 property cards), TV mode w/ back nav, Finance, 11 secondary routes, all 8 placeholder pages, logout. No blocking console errors. Note: initial 502 Bad Gateway was transient during frontend restart; retried and succeeded.

Dashboard shows kpi-vgv, kpi-deals, kpi-leads, kpi-conversion + charts
notifications-btn opens popover, mark-all-read clears items
/leads: search, btn-new-lead → lead-name → save-lead flow works
/crm: 6 kanban-col-* columns, 18 deal-card-* cards; tab-list ↔ tab-kanban switch

All 8 placeholder pages (inbox, whatsapp, instagram, chatbot, marketing, automations, ai, sites) render with proper testids
